title: Regeneration
text:
Regeneration is a form of recovery method for some resources, most commonly life and mana. Regeneration gives the appropriate resource a constant recovery per second rate.


== Mechanics ==
Player characters innately have a mana regeneration rate equal to 4% of their maximum mana per second.
